atoms.text: Henry dreams of becoming a concert pianist, but first, he needs to learn how to play. Help Henry find a plan, or strategy, that will help him achieve his goal.

instruction.text: Choose the strategies that might help Henry reach his goal.

hint.text: A strategy is a thought-out plan designed to bring you closer to a goal.
hint.label: Strategy

sound: setting a smaller goal of practising every day for 15 minutes
asking his parents if he can have a teacher once per week
not getting discouraged when he doesn’t do it perfectly right away

atoms.text: Joanna wants to earn some pocket money to save for a new bike by doing extra chores. Help her decide which habits would help her achieve this goal.

instruction.text: Choose the strategies that might help Joanna reach her goal.

hint.text: A strategy is a thought-out plan designed to bring you closer to a goal.
hint.label: Strategy

atoms.a: saving to buy a new bike
sound: doing her chores every day before school
asking her parents for other chores
putting her chore money in a safe place where she won’t spend it

atoms.text: Sophia wants to convince her parents she is responsible enough for a puppy. Help Sophia think of some strategies so that she can prove she is ready for a dog.

instruction.text: Choose the strategies that might help Sophia reach her goal.

atoms.a: proving her responsibility in order to get a puppy
sound: helping her parents around the house
borrowing books from the library about dog training
volunteering to look after the neighbour’s dog

atoms.text: Phillip just got his maths test back, and he wasn’t happy with his mark. This term, his goal is to improve his test results.

instruction.text: Choose the strategies that might help Phillip reach his goal.

sound: doing his homework every day right after school
asking his teacher for help when he doesn’t understand completely
beginning to study for tests earlier
organising his maths folder so he can find his notes easily
